title: 第3章 报仇雪恨
content_zh:
村东头，严冰和林梦如穿戴一新，神采飞扬，被众多杂役围着送行，犹如众星捧月。

“严冰大人前途无量，以后进了正玄派，还要多照顾照顾小的们啊。”

“祝愿严冰大人早日修成仙人，我们这些杂役也能跟着鸡犬升天！”

“严冰大人和梦如姑娘就是一对神仙眷侣，真让人羡慕啊。”

众杂役谀辞潮涌，唯恐严冰和林梦如记不住自己。

林梦如嘴角微翘，神情淡然，对众人理也不理，宛如高高在上的贵妇人。

严冰只是淡淡的微笑着，算是回应，他的目光望向远方的正玄山，似乎在这一刻，已经看到自己无限美妙的锦绣前程。

砰！一道人影突然从远处飞来，摔在他面前，抽搐了几下便一动不动了。

李非？看到那不知道是死是活的人影，众人大吃一惊，顿时安静下来。

“严冰，飞升成仙的美梦做得不错吧，没关系，我很快就会让你变成噩梦！”夏尘背负着手大踏步走近，慢条斯理地道。

“夏尘，你敢打我的人？”严冰脸色铁青。

“我不但打你的人，还要打你，不但打你，还要废掉你，你想做正玄派的内门弟子，可惜，从现在开始，你永远也不可能有踏入山门的机会了。”夏尘缓缓地道。

“哈哈哈，这真是我听到过最荒唐的笑话。”严冰怒极反笑，就要上前，“可怜虫，你是在威胁我吗？好吧，李非他们无能，那我就亲手送你上路。”

“严冰，不要动手。”林梦如冷眼旁观，这才开口道，“今天是你上山的好日子，别因为一个杂役败兴，我们现在最重要的事是入门，不是跟他争斗。”

她又怜悯地看着夏尘：“看在过去的情分上，我最后劝你一句，你跟严冰没法比的，所以你赶快离开吧。放心，严冰不会废掉你的，因为没这个必要，你就继续当你的杂役……”

林梦如忽然说不下去了，脸色也渐渐变了，因为她发现夏尘看着她的表情，就象是要呕吐。

“林梦如，我只奇怪一件事情，我以前怎么会喜欢你这种女人的。”夏尘一字一顿道。

“你！”林梦如全身发凉，仿佛堕入冰窟中。

“夏尘，你算老几？也敢挑衅严冰大人和梦如姑娘，我实在看不下去了，对付你这种货色，用不着大人出手，我就足以教训你这可怜虫了！”

突然，一名三十多岁的高大杂役越众而出，口里大声喝着，向着夏尘狠狠扑来。

“不错，夏尘，你和严冰大人作对，就是和我们整个杂役村作对！”

“严冰大人，梦如姑娘，我们先把这个白痴揍得半死，然后再交由你们处置。”

砰！那高大杂役脸庞鲜血飞溅，惨叫着向后飞起来，将几名来不及躲避的杂役砸翻在地，随即便昏了过去。

鼓噪的声音瞬间消失，这高大杂役身手颇为不错，却连夏尘一拳都接不下来。

众杂役鸦雀无声，脸上充满了惧色，哪还敢再动手。

严冰和林梦如面色震惊，严冰心头更是升起深深地寒意，就算他修炼出真气感应，也不可能一拳就将这杂役击飞，这个夏尘，怎么突然变得这么强？

“如果没人，严冰，轮到你了。”夏尘淡淡地道，缓缓走过去。

林梦如颤声道：“严冰，你不要和他打，我们快走，等入门之后，再对付他。”

不知道为什么，她忽然有种无名而巨大的恐惧，恐怕今天的事很难善了。

“不，我为什么走？我堂堂正玄派弟子，岂会怕一个杂役。”严冰愤怒吼道，“夏尘，你既然被我踩在脚下，就一辈子都别想翻身，我杀了你。”

他怒吼着冲上去，向夏尘狠狠击出一拳。

夏尘面色平静，修炼到后天一重，他无论是力量、眼力还是敏捷程度都得到极大强化，虽然只修习一些最粗浅的功夫，但是相比严冰，两人已完全不可同日而语。

啪！夏尘扬手抓住严冰的拳头，后天一重真气汹涌而出，犹如刀锋一般进入严冰体内。

“啊！”严冰凄厉的惨叫起来，全身如同筛糠般的哆嗦着，仿佛被电击，那种痛苦简直无法忍受。

夏尘一拳将严冰击倒在地，脚踩在他的头上，慢条斯理道：“严冰，没想到吧，昨天你刚刚对我做过的一切，今天就全都颠倒过来了，我兑现我的承诺，怎么样，这滋味是否很爽？”

“混蛋，不可能，你不可能比我强……”严冰犹如濒死的野兽般嚎叫着。

夏尘冰冷的声音从他头上传来：“严冰，当杂役的时候，你就被我压着，现在你不是杂役了，依然要被我压着，你的威风就只有昨天一天，昙花一现，你真够可怜的。”

他用力踩着严冰的头，一脚一脚狠狠的踏着，几乎把严冰整张脸都踩到了泥土里，严冰拼命挣扎着，却无济于事。

“住手！夏尘。”林梦如尖叫道，“你知不知道，严冰现在是正玄派内门弟子，你只不过是个杂役，敢殴打他，正玄派会把你处死的。”

“哦？你不说我都忘了。”夏尘露出恍然的神色，一把提起严冰，“严冰大人，你痛吗？”

“夏尘，你敢伤我。”严冰脸上混着泥土和鲜血，英俊的脸庞早已变形，说不出的狼狈，他疯狂的叫道，“我一定会禀告门派，把你挫骨扬灰，让你不得好死的。”

“我真的好怕呀。”夏尘嘴角泛起冷酷无比的笑意，“不过，严冰大人，你说我要把你废掉，正玄派还会要你当内门弟子吗？”

“你……你想干什么？你千万别乱来。”严冰瞬间清醒过来，吓得全身发抖。

“你敢！夏尘，如果你废掉严冰，正玄派纵使不要他，也肯定会把你处死的。”林梦如也要疯了，她毫不容易才攀上严冰这条大船，如果严冰被废掉，那她等于什么都没得到，还要担上负心者的名声。

“是吗？”夏尘淡淡道，“如果正玄派知道我修炼出真气，还会不会处死我呢？我想一个废人，一个是有着真气的弟子，正玄派很容易就做出选择吧。”

“你修炼出真气感应？”犹如晴天霹雳，林梦如和严冰惊得呆了。

“如假包换！”夏尘淡淡一笑，真气骤然涌出，顺流直下，狠狠打在严冰的丹田。

严冰狂叫一声，口中鲜血泉涌，小腹丹田处传来火烧般的疼痛，却再也感应不到任何真气。

噗通！夏尘一把将严冰甩在地上，严冰哆嗦着，他脸色灰败，眼神里透出深深地绝望，再也说不出一句话。

完了，彻底完了，夏尘废了他，就等于是废了他的人生，从此以后，再也没有可能踏上修行之路。

夏尘一脚将死狗般的严冰踢到林梦如面前，看着这个前女友无比惊恐的表情，感到前所未有的快慰。

“林梦如，你跟我分手，不就是想奔个好前途么，可惜你看到了，你的前途就被我踩在脚下！你想得到更多，结果什么也没得到，这是你活该如此……我不会把你怎么样，因为我对你已经没有任何感觉，你只是个平庸的女人。”

夏尘缓缓说着，每一个字都化作利刃，狠狠地切割着林梦如的心。

林梦如全身发抖，面如死灰，她心里后悔到了极点，后悔得甚至想一头撞死。

是她有眼无珠，亲手打碎了自己的幸福，而且毅然决然的断送本应该更好的前程，更可悲的是，她还以为自己所做的一切是正确的，现在看来，其实只是把自己推向了更加不堪屈辱的境地。

过去的记忆潮水般涌上心头，化成悔恨的泪水成串的流下来，望着曾经熟悉但是现在却已经拉开了巨大鸿沟的夏尘，林梦如凄凉的惨笑起来。

“夏尘，我知道我很愚蠢，也很可悲，我瞎了眼睛，错过了你，我不敢奢求你的原谅，也没脸再见你，今日只有一死，为我对你所做过的谢罪。”

说着，林梦如从怀里掏出一柄匕首，向着自己的心窝狠狠刺去。

这一幕来得极为突然，众人顿时都惊呆了。

夏尘闪电般的跃到林梦如身旁，千钧一发之际扣住她手腕，林梦如的手立即松开，匕首掉在地上。

“林梦如，我用不着你为我死，我们之间已经过去了，我现在对你，无爱亦无憎，所以你也可以追求你想要的生活，珍惜生命，你懂么？”夏尘淡然道，然后松开她的手腕。

林梦如娇躯颤抖，泪水止不住的流下来，她说不出话来，只是用力点了点头。

她受屈辱不过，本来只想求死，但是没想到夏尘居然会救她，想死的心倒是瞬间淡了，但是心里却涌起浓浓的苦涩滋味。

从此以后，她和夏尘便再没有任何可能交集，那曾经过往的青春，再也回不去了。

众杂役看着，都是不胜唏嘘，没想到事情竟然是这个结果。

夏尘头也不回，大踏步向着正玄山走去，在说出这番话后，他的心里也彻底放下了一切，有着说不出的轻松。

content_en:
At the east end of the village, Yan Bing and Lin Mengru were newly dressed and in high spirits. They were surrounded by many servants to see them off, like stars holding the moon.

"Master Yan Bing has a bright future. If he joins the Zhengxuan Sect in the future, he will have to take more care of the younger ones."

"I wish Master Yan Bing can become an immortal soon, and we handymen can follow the chickens and dogs to heaven!"

"Master Yan Bing and Miss Meng Ru are a couple of gods and goddesses. They are so enviable."

There was a flood of flattery from all the servants, fearing that Yan Bing and Lin Mengru would not remember him.

The corners of Lin Mengru's mouth were slightly raised, her expression was indifferent, and she ignored everyone, just like a high-ranking lady.

Yan Bing just smiled faintly as a response. He looked towards Zhengxuan Mountain in the distance, as if at this moment, he had seen his infinitely wonderful future.

Bang!A figure suddenly flew from a distance, fell in front of him, twitched a few times and then became motionless.

Li Fei?Seeing the figure who didn't know whether he was dead or alive, everyone was shocked and suddenly became quiet.

"Yan Bing, you did a good job in your dream of ascending to immortality. It doesn't matter, I will soon turn you into a nightmare!" Xia Chen strode closer with his hands on his back and said slowly.

"Xia Chen, you dare to hit my people?" Yan Bing's face was ashen.

"I will not only beat you, but I will also beat you. Not only will I beat you, but I will also destroy you. You want to be an inner disciple of the Zhengxuan Sect. Unfortunately, from now on, you will never have the chance to step into the mountain gate." Xia Chen said slowly.

"Hahaha, this is really the most ridiculous joke I have ever heard." Yan Bing laughed angrily and was about to step forward, "Poor thing, are you threatening me? Well, Li Fei and the others are incompetent, then I will personally send you on your way."

"Yan Bing, don't do anything." Lin Mengru looked on coldly and then said, "Today is a good day for you to go up the mountain. Don't let a handyman let you down. The most important thing for us now is to get started, not to fight with him."

She looked at Xia Chen with pity: "Looking at the past relationship, I would like to advise you one last time. You are incomparable to Yan Bing, so you should leave as soon as possible. Don't worry, Yan Bing will not destroy you. Because there is no need, you can continue to be your handyman..."

Lin Mengru suddenly couldn't speak anymore, and her expression gradually changed, because she noticed that Xia Chen looked at her with an expression that looked like she was about to vomit.

"Lin Mengru, I only wonder about one thing. How could I like a woman like you before?" Xia Chen said word by word.

"You!" Lin Mengru's whole body felt cold, as if she had fallen into an ice cave.

"Xia Chen, who are you? You dare to provoke Lord Yan Bing and Miss Meng Ru. I really can't stand it. To deal with people like you, I don't need to take action. I can teach you a lesson!"

Suddenly, a tall handyman in his thirties came out of the crowd, drank loudly, and rushed towards Xia Chen.

"That's right, Xia Chen, if you go against Master Yan Bing, you are going against our entire handyman village!"

"Master Yan Bing, Miss Meng Ru, let's beat this idiot half to death first, and then leave it to your disposal."

Bang!The tall handyman's face was spattered with blood, and he screamed and flew backwards, knocking several handymen who had no time to avoid to the ground, and then passed out.

The noisy voice disappeared instantly. This tall handyman was quite skilled, but he couldn't even catch Xia Chen's punch.

The servants were silent, their faces full of fear, how could they dare to take action again.

Yan Bing and Lin Mengru looked shocked, and Yan Bing felt a deep chill in his heart. Even if he cultivated Qi Sensing, he would not be able to knock the handyman away with one punch. Why did this Xia Chen suddenly become so strong?

"If there is no one, Yan Bing, it's your turn." Xia Chen said calmly and walked over slowly.

Lin Mengru said in a trembling voice: "Yan Bing, don't fight him. Let's leave quickly and deal with him after we get in."

She didn't know why, but she suddenly felt a nameless and huge fear. I was afraid that things would not go well today.

"No, why should I leave? How could I, a disciple of the upright Xuan Sect, be afraid of a handyman?" Yan Bing roared angrily, "Xia Chen, since you have been stepped on by me, you will never stand up for the rest of your life. I will kill you."

He roared and rushed forward, punching Xia Chen hard.

Xia Chen's face was calm. After practicing to the acquired level one, his strength, eyesight and agility were greatly enhanced. Although he only practiced some of the most superficial kung fu, compared to Yan Bing, the two were completely different.

Snap!Xia Chen raised his hand and grabbed Yan Bing's fist, and the acquired true energy surged out and entered Yan Bing's body like a blade.

"Ah!" Yan Bing screamed miserably, his whole body shivering like chaff, as if he had been shocked by electricity, the pain was simply unbearable.

Xia Chen punched Yan Bing to the ground, stepped on his head, and said slowly: "Yan Bing, you didn't expect that everything you just did to me yesterday has been reversed today. I will fulfill my promise. How about it? Does it feel good?"

"Asshole, it's impossible, you can't be stronger than me..." Yan Bing howled like a dying beast.

Xia Chen's cold voice came from above his head: "Yan Bing, when you were a handyman, you were suppressed by me. Now that you are no longer a handyman, you are still suppressed by me. Your prestige is only one day, and it is short-lived. You are really pitiful."

He stepped hard on Yan Bing's head, one foot after another, almost forcing Yan Bing's entire face into the dirt. Yan Bing struggled desperately, but to no avail.

"Stop! Xia Chen." Lin Mengru screamed, "Do you know that Yan Bing is now an inner disciple of the Zhengxuan Sect. You are just a handyman. If you dare to beat him, the Zhengxuan Sect will kill you."

"Oh? If you didn't tell me, I would have forgotten it." Xia Chen looked stunned and mentioned Yan Bing, "Master Yan Bing, are you in pain?"

"Xia Chen, you dare to hurt me." Yan Bing's face was mixed with mud and blood, his handsome face had long been deformed, and he was in an indescribable embarrassment. He shouted crazily, "I will definitely report it to the sect and crush you to ashes, so that you will not die well."

"I'm really scared." A cold smile appeared at the corner of Xia Chen's mouth, "But, Lord Yan Bing, if you say I want to destroy you, will the Zhengxuan Sect still want you to be an inner disciple?"

"You...what do you want to do? Don't mess around." Yan Bing woke up instantly, trembling with fear.

"You dare! Xia Chen, if you abolish Yan Bing, the Zhengxuan Sect will definitely execute you even if they don't want him." Lin Mengru is also going crazy. It was not easy for her to climb onto Yan Bing's ship. If Yan Bing is abolished, she will get nothing and will have to bear the reputation of a heartless person.

"Really?" Xia Chen said lightly, "If the Zhengxuan Sect knows that I have cultivated true energy, will they execute me? I think it will be easy for the Zhengxuan Sect to make a choice between a useless person and a disciple with true energy."

"Have you developed Qi induction?" Like a bolt from the blue, Lin Mengru and Yan Bing were stunned.

"It's true!" Xia Chen smiled faintly, and his true energy suddenly surged out, flowing straight down, hitting Yan Bing's Dantian hard.

Yan Bing screamed wildly, blood gushed out from his mouth, and there was a burning pain in the Dantian of his lower abdomen, but he could no longer feel any true energy.

Plop!Xia Chen threw Yan Bing to the ground. Yan Bing was trembling. His face was gray and his eyes were full of despair, and he could no longer say a word.

It's over, it's completely over. Xia Chen has ruined him, which is equivalent to ruining his life. From now on, it will never be possible to embark on the path of cultivation.

Xia Chen kicked Yan Bing, who was like a dead dog, in front of Lin Mengru. Looking at his ex-girlfriend's horrified expression, he felt unprecedented pleasure.

"Lin Mengru, when you broke up with me, didn't you just want to have a good future? Unfortunately, you saw that your future was trampled under my feet! You wanted more, but in the end you got nothing. You deserve this... I won't do anything to you, because I have no feelings for you anymore, you are just a mediocre woman."

Xia Chen spoke slowly, and every word turned into a sharp blade, cutting Lin Mengru's heart fiercely.

Lin Mengru was trembling all over and her face was ashen. She felt so regretful that she even wanted to kill her headlong.

It was her blindness that shattered her own happiness with her own hands, and resolutely ruined what should have been a better future. What's even more tragic is that she thought everything she did was right, but now it seems that it actually just pushed herself into an even more humiliating situation.

Memories of the past flooded into his heart, turning into tears of regret and flowing down in strings. Looking at Xia Chen, who was once familiar but now has a huge gap, Lin Mengru smiled miserably.

"Xia Chen, I know I am stupid and pathetic. I am blind and have missed you. I dare not ask for your forgiveness and I have no shame to see you again. I only have one chance to die today to apologize for what I have done to you."

As he spoke, Lin Mengru took out a dagger from his arms and stabbed himself hard in the heart.

This scene happened so suddenly that everyone was stunned.

Xia Chen jumped to Lin Mengru's side like lightning and grabbed her wrist at the critical moment. Lin Mengru's hand immediately let go and the dagger fell to the ground.

"Lin Mengru, I don't need you to die for me. Things have passed between us. I have no love or hatred for you now, so you can pursue the life you want and cherish life, do you understand?" Xia Chen said calmly, and then let go of her wrist.

Lin Mengru's delicate body trembled, and her tears couldn't stop flowing down. She was speechless and just nodded her head vigorously.

She couldn't bear the humiliation. She originally just wanted to die, but she didn't expect that Xia Chen would actually save her. Her desire to die instantly faded away, but a strong bitter taste surged in her heart.

From then on, there was no possibility of her and Xia Chen intersecting, and the youth that had passed could never be returned.

The servants looked at it and were all sighing. They didn't expect that things would turn out like this.

Xia Chen didn't look back and strode towards Zhengxuan Mountain. After saying these words, he completely let go of everything and felt indescribably relaxed.
